profile.headline: Vice President of Engineering & Technology Executive

summary: Engineering executive with fifteen years of experience scaling high-performance engineering organizations, driving enterprise product velocity, and aligning technical roadmaps with business revenue targets. Built engineering departments from seed stage to post-IPO enterprise scale. Fictional sample resume.
